title: Aloo, tamatar, mirch - Indian nahi hain! Portuguese laaye
source: Asia Times · Wikipedia (Origins of North Indian foods) · Heidelberg University (food history)

captions.instagram:
Potato, tomato, chilli... not one of them is Indian!

Aloo, tamatar, mirch: inme se ek bhi Indian nahi hai 🥔🍅🌶️

🥔🍅🌶️ Teeno America ke hain aur Portuguese vyapari inhe Bharat laaye. Aur tamatar aam taur par 1800s mein jaake khaaya jaane laga!

Sources: Asia Times, Wikipedia, Heidelberg University Publishing.
Photos: JimReeves / Flickr (CC BY 2.0); 16:9clue / Flickr (CC BY 2.0).

Comment karo: aapki favourite sabzi kaunsi hai? 👇

Aloo ke bina kaunsi dish sochi bhi nahi ja sakti? 👇

• Chillies were brought to India by the Portuguese (via Goa) — Asia Times
• The potato was likely introduced by Portuguese traders around 1600 — Wikipedia (Origins of North Indian and Pakistani foods)
• The tomato arrived earlier, but routine use in Indian cooking is recorded only from the first half of the 19th century — Heidelberg University Publishing (food history)
